symptoms: Numerous small, irregular purplish-red blotches on upper leaf surfaces
Blotches enlarge and merge without a white center, turning leaves brown and scorched
Calyx (fruit cap) infection causing brown withered fruit tops
risk_factors: Warm, humid weather with frequent rain or overhead sprinkler watering
prevention: Plant resistant strawberry cultivars in well-draining raised beds
Mow and remove infected foliage immediately after harvest (renovation)
recommended_actions: Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl fungicides during spring flower and runner development
